summaryZh: Kravets Lab 研究糖尿病发生机制，关注免疫系统为何开始攻击分泌胰岛素的β细胞，以及健康、1型和2型糖尿病中β细胞功能网络的可塑性。具体项目涉及免疫与内分泌细胞的接触、α与β细胞相互作用及胰岛电生理模拟。
researchQuestions: 免疫系统为何以及如何开始攻击分泌胰岛素的β细胞？
β细胞功能网络的可塑性在健康和糖尿病状态下如何变化？
topics: 糖尿病发生与β细胞免疫攻击
β细胞功能网络可塑性与胰岛电生理
methods: 计算模型与电生理模拟

evidence.quote: Kravets Lab Principal Investigator: Vira Kravets
Kravets Lab Laboratory of Dr. Vira Kravets at UCSD
Our goal is to understand the pathogenesis of diabetes . Specifically, how and why the immune attack on insulin-producing β-cells begins.
We aim to discover patterns of functional β-cell network plasticity in health and disease (Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes).

Selected projects include: Patterns of contact-based immunoendocrine interactions during onset of Type 1 diabetes. GLP1-R mediated role of alpha-beta cell interactions in insulin response to glucose. Computation simulations of electrophysiology of pancreatic islets to study role of electrical and metabolic components of insulin-producing cells.
Approaches: Targeted 2-photon laser ablation, Confocal microscopy , Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging, C omputational models, Network (graph) theory, L ive pancreatic tissue with and without diabetes.
